title: Apache OFBiz resolveURI Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of Apache OFBiz. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the resolveURI method. The issue results from improper URI validation. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system.
